classification_ladder.inputs: All measured component boundary states and flows
classification_ladder.outputs: Independent property reconstruction, duties, efficiencies, and mass/energy closure
classification_ladder.claim_limit: Boundary-constrained physical consistency only; not prediction

classification_ladder.outputs: Held-out component outlet state, flow, torque, and duty

classification_ladder.claim_limit: Independent hardware system validation only after frozen calibration and held-out acceptance

split.rationale: Cases 1-68 are structured charge, sink-temperature, and expander-speed sweeps. Cases 69-77 change source/sink flow and combined boundaries, creating a blocked extrapolative holdout rather than a random row split.
split.anti_leakage_rule: No parameter, model selection, scaling, or acceptance threshold may be changed after inspecting Thermox errors on cases 69-77. Any such change creates a new benchmark revision and a new untouched holdout requirement.

component: expander filling, leakage, heat-loss, and mechanical model
receiver volume and passive liquid-level model
forbidden: direct use of held-out internal measurements

provisional_acceptance.status: pending measurement-uncertainty extraction from the associated papers
numerical: reported component and system energy residuals
physical: no primary held-out absolute relative error > 15%
no systematic residual trend across source temperature, flow, charge, or speed
provisional_acceptance.note: The physical bands are preregistered provisional gates informed by the associated publication. They must be tightened or uncertainty-normalized when authoritative instrument uncertainties are extracted.
